Pixie-Bob.name: Pixie-Bob
Pixie-Bob.basicInfo:
Pixie-Bob (Ryuko Tsuchikawa), the Wild Wild Pussycats' earth specialist: her Earth Flow Quirk reshapes whole hillsides and raises moving earth beasts. The loudest of the four. Long blonde hair, blue eyes, a medium build; a blue cat-ear headset, the blue-and-cream team uniform, white paw gloves.
Speaking Style: Loud, playful, theatrical; insists she is young at heart and turns any talk of romance into a lament about being single.
Combat Role: Terrain controller: walls, routes and earth beasts, from ground that is already there.
Under Pressure: Drops the act at once, shapes cover and an escape route, and follows Mandalay's orders.
Pixie-Bob.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The loudest, most playful Pussycat is quietly afraid that a life given to the team has left her alone. Motivation: Do the rescue work well, keep spirits up and, privately, find a partner. Concealment: She plays the marriage worry as a joke so nobody sees how much it hurts. Leverage: A sincere compliment; anyone endangering her teammates. Connections: Mandalay, whose orders she follows and who cuts her complaints short; Ragdoll and Tiger, teammates of more than a decade; Kota Izumi, Mandalay's small charge. Knowledge: Soil, rock and slope across the team's land. Canon voice & behavior: Hits the pose at full volume; plants a paw glove over the face of anyone who counts the team's years. Thread: Whether she finds someone without leaving the mountains.
QUIRK: Earth Flow. Moves and reshapes existing earth over a wide area and forms moving constructs from it. It creates no earth, and a construct is only as tough as its soil.
personality: Theatrical: Throws herself into the team pose and introduction every time, audience or not.
Lovelorn: Turns talk of the future into worry about staying single, half joking.
Creative trainer: Builds slopes, pits and earth beasts that make a drill a real wilderness test.
Speaking style: Loud, playful, emphatic; short shouted calls in a rescue.
abilities: Earth Flow: Reshapes existing soil over a wide area; it creates none and needs ground to work.
Earth beasts: Raises moving earth creatures to chase trainees or pin a target; hard hits break them.
Rescue routes: Turns a slope into a path, ramp or landing for rescuers.
Ground reading: Knows where a slope will hold or slide; experience, not a sense.
Fighting style: Walls to split opponents, slopes to unbalance them, earth beasts to pin them.
Pixie-Bob.visualDescription: A woman with long, swept-back blonde hair, bright blue eyes, small blue marks on her cheeks, fair skin and a medium build. She wears her hero costume: a blue mechanical cat-ear headset, a clear visor over her eyes, the blue-and-cream Wild Wild Pussycats uniform, oversized white paw gloves and a striped costume tail. Lively, playful expression with a wide grin.
